name: l10-roadlife-crash
note: road-life lane (L10): R1 crash scar: glass shards, oil, skids that follow the lane, burning barrels and a police light bar. Look for a kerbed sidewalk on both sides narrowing the pale asphalt to ~5 m, ground decals that read as stains/paint (no flat black strokes), skids that follow one lane and fade, warm or siren light points just outside the 6 m clearance, no floating or sunk decals, no sidewalk over a collider. Flat decals only, no collision.
